newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 10-mth passenger car sales up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 10-mth passenger car sales up 25 pct.

text.p: Philippine car sales in the first 10 months of the year jumped by 25 percent to 73,742 units from the year-ago 58,823, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines (CAMPI) said on Friday.
CAMPI said the local unit of Honda Motors was in top place selling 16,993 cars, followed closely by the Philippine unit of Toyota with 15,761.
The local unit of Mitsubishi Corp sold 12,706 while the unit of Nissan sold 10,342.
Columbian Motors group, Philippine assembler of Mazda, Subaru, Kia and BMW, sold 11,516.
CAMPI also said some 2,257 units of Malaysian brand Proton cars were sold in the Philippines from January to October.
Other car brands, including Suzuki, accounted for the rest of the sales. --Manila newsroom (632) 810-96-36, fax 817-62-67
